scope: 231 public tasks only; not the complete JevBench benchmark or an official leaderboard score

protocol.timing: Serial in-process evaluate_with_trace; CUDA synchronized; model loading, hashing, three synthetic warmups, and disk writes excluded; cache disabled
protocol.mapping: Original state/instructions/criteria; upstream build_question; no prompt rewriting or label leakage
protocol.scoring: Upstream Runner and summarize; Score accuracy uses argmax, ordinal MAE uses expected level; Noul maps to yes=p/no=1-p
